posts.name: Student
posts.cooked: Where can I access the questions of OPPE held on 16th August? If anyone can recall questions, please mention.

posts.name: ASHVIN GANESHRAO AMBATWAR
posts.cooked:
Hi @sayan Sir,

Where can I find the SC OPPE question paper for practice. Its true that now the exam is over but I want to go though the questions once again. Because of less practice I was not able to answer all the questions. But now I want to face the fear. Need to go though the same paper which we have in recent OPPE exam.

Can you please tell me where I can find this question paper and do the needful.

posts.name: Madhav Rimal
posts.cooked:
I kinda remember the pattern,

  1. use grep command to extract info from log /etc/passwd like
  2. fabonachi triangle printing question
  3. sed based words replacement question
  4. awk based sheet suming problem

SO their you go , revisit these

posts.name: S.Vignesh
posts.cooked:
Here is a compressed archive of the OPPE files. It contains the se2001/oppe_1.* folders as well as opt folder with se2001/oppe_1.* folders.

Download the tar.gz file in your local linux machine. To extract, use the command

tar -xvzf oppe.tar.gz

in the directory you want to save the folders.

Download OPPE 2025
